Daikaijuu Battle - Ultra Coliseum.name: Daikaijuu Battle: Ultra Coliseum
Daikaijuu Battle - Ultra Coliseum.summary: Mega Monster Battle: Ultra Coliseum (大怪獣足取り ウルトラコロシアム Daikaiju Batoru Urutora Koroshiumu) is the first Ultra Galaxy video game released for Wii only. It's released to coincide the series Ultra Galaxy Mega Monster Battle: Never Ending Odyssey. This game is succeeded by Mega Monster Battle: Ultra Coliseum DX: The Gathering of The Ultra Heroes!

MySims SkyHeroes.name: MySims SkyHeroes
MySims SkyHeroes.summary:
Take to the sky to lead the resistance against Morcubus and his drone army and to stop his plans to take over the skyways. MySims SkyHeroes is an all new adventure that brings the thrill and high speed action of flying to the creative, immersive world of MySims.
Go from unknown pilot to celebrated hero as you defeat dangerous enemies in aerial dogfights, test your reflexes in fast-paced speed challenges, and take on massive enemy bosses that demand all your skill as a pilot to survive. As you progress, you build, customize and tune your aircraft to give you an edge in combat – upgrade your wings for swifter maneuvers, switch out your engine for a speed boost, or change the paint job to camouflage your plane and avoid enemy fire.
Face Morcubus’ drones with an ally in split-screen cooperative gameplay, or take the game online to challenge your friends in fun, competitive 10-player high speed action.
Morcubus and his drones must be stopped; will you rise to the challenge?!

New Unou Kids Wii.name: New Unou Kids Wii
New Unou Kids Wii.summary: New Unou Kids Wii is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by IE Institute, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Space Camp.name: Space Camp
Space Camp.summary: In Space Camp you begin as an aspiring astronaut in training. After rocketing yourself to the moon, you must engage in a series of futuristic, furiously fun missions in order to return home to Earth. With the help of your own robot, you will perform activities like scientific experimentation, controlling spacecraft and even defending the moon from invaders.
